candidate_claims.statement: The author has expressed thanks to the glorious Red Army for the help given us regaining North Transylvania.
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: I have expressed My thanks to the glorious Red Army for the help given us regaining North Transylvania which has always been so dear to the hearts of all true Romanians.

candidate_claims.statement: North Transylvania has always been so dear to the hearts of all true Romanians.
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: North Transylvania which has always been so dear to the hearts of all true Romanians.

candidate_claims.statement: The author begs the recipient to listen to the voice of the Romanian Nation.
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: I beg you to listen to the voice of the Romanian Nation.

candidate_claims.statement: The author is held by a painful and serious anxiety as to our future.
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: At the present time, I am held by a painful and serious anxiety as to our future, having observed the attitude of various representatives of the U.R.S.S. in Romania, who in many cases have not at all understood our problems.

candidate_claims.statement: The author wishes to call Your attention to the inclosed note,9 which sets forth some of the reasons of My anxiety.

candidate_claims.statement: The author hopes that in the future Romania can faithfully wait for the happy effects and beneficial influences of a just judgment by the President of the Great United States of America.
